method: Full private exam paragraphs/table cells screened for normalized ten-word contiguous overlap with revised stems, followed by manual scenario, data and answer-pattern review. This screen alone cannot establish originality.
manualReview: No revised stem reproduces a distinctive exam scenario, numeric combination or answer-option pattern. Revisions use reverse accounts, error diagnoses, multi-period changes, competing mechanisms and conditional evidence. The two identified close/exact pre-existing arithmetic parallels were changed to distinct reasoning structures. Generic definitions remaining in the unchanged bank are not an exam reconstruction.
studyGuideUsed: Secondary coverage/formula boundary, not a difficulty rubric or instruction to rewrite every topic.
